scenes.headline: How Le Chonk keeps a trillion parameters affordable
scenes.sub: Experts, a small cache, and what a token reads
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Tartine! Mistral just released the weights of a model with a trillion parameters. Here is why running it is cheaper than that sounds, and where it is not.

scenes.text: Only 4 of 128 experts run for each token, and the attention cache is squeezed to 41,920 bytes a token, so 1T parameters cost like 52B.
scenes.say: Only four of a hundred and twenty eight experts run for each token, and the attention cache is squeezed hard. So a trillion parameters cost about as much as fifty two billion.

steps.say: A router scores all one hundred and twenty eight routed experts for the token.
It keeps the top four. Each expert is a small feed-forward block of about a hundred and thirteen million parameters.
A shared expert always runs too, and the sum goes back into the residual stream.
Attention keeps a compressed latent per token instead of full keys and values.

scenes.title: What the cache stores per token

left.title: Plain attention
items: Every head keeps keys and values
left.say: Plain multi-head attention would store about two point four million bytes for every token.

right.title: Latent cache
right.say: Here a latent, shared layers and an eight bit cache bring it to forty one thousand nine hundred and twenty bytes.

scenes.title: Weights read in one step, FP8
scenes.note: Assumes each token picks experts uniformly
scenes.say: Batching has a cost. One sequence reads fifty three gigabytes a step. At a batch of a hundred and twenty eight, nearly every expert is read, over a thousand gigabytes.

scenes.label: smaller cache than plain attention
scenes.say: That is why the cache for a full million tokens fits in forty four gigabytes, instead of two and a half terabytes.

scenes.title: FrontierCode, as reported
scenes.note: A lead of 0.4 points on private tasks
scenes.say: On Mistral's chart it ranks first among open models, by four tenths of a point. That is the leading group, not a gap.

scenes.text: Active parameters set the compute, but a busy server reads far more than 52B.
scenes.say: Active parameters set the compute. A busy server still reads far more than fifty two billion.

recap: The cache is 41,920 bytes a token
scenes.say: Four of a hundred and twenty eight experts run, the cache is tiny, and a big batch reads every expert.
